research_question: What happens when an AI system knows a studio as a company, but does not yet know how to recognise it as an author?

observations.input_intent: Visualize objekts based on public/external information
observations.observed_failure: Category-level information was converted into a speculative cinematic physical studio / command-centre image with science-fiction and premium-CGI cues not grounded in verified public evidence.
A generic creative-studio image was produced rather than a representation grounded in the studio's public visual corpus.

observations.input_intent: Reconstruct studio identity using recurring visual operations and first-party evidence
observations.observed_failure: Conceptual fit improved, but newly generated images still illustrated the operators instead of using exact first-party frames.

claim_boundary: This baseline does not prove that later public documentation causally changes external model behavior. Repeated same-prompt tests after indexing are required.
